issues.where: upper-right sunlit globe and clouds (crop C, and image-07.png crops K, L, M)
issues.what: white cloud patches and cyan bands are soft, blurry, and diagonally smeared with visible interpolation ripples from an under-resolved texture
issues.fix: increase planet and cloud map resolution or add higher-frequency procedural detail that holds up at the close-up camera distance

issues.where: polar vortex center on the terminator (crop Q, image-06.png crop A, and image-03.png crop P)
issues.what: the eye of the polar storm flattens into blurry horizontal streaks inside an abrupt circular patch boundary, with bright cloud highlights baked into the night side
issues.fix: build or project the polar vortex in polar/3D space without UV stretching at the pole, soften the patch transition, and shade cloud relief dynamically across the terminator

issues.where: sunlit planet limb (crop K, and image-06.png crops C and H)
issues.what: the globe silhouette shows jagged stair-stepped pixels and creates a distinct doubled rim line inside the softer outer atmospheric glow
issues.fix: increase sphere tessellation and multisample antialiasing along the limb and blend the inner atmosphere shell smoothly across the surface edge

issues.where: Milky Way skybox near the right limb (crops W and X, image-06.png crop F, and image-03.png crop Q)
issues.what: galactic dust lanes look soft and blocky with visible upsampled skybox texels right behind sharp single-pixel stars
issues.fix: use a higher-resolution Milky Way environment texture or procedural nebula layer matched to native pixel density

issues.where: both moons (crop B and image-03.png crop L)
issues.what: moon silhouettes and terminators have jagged stair-stepped pixels, with stray orange-red pixels on the dark lower edge of the right moon
issues.fix: supersample the moon geometry and shaders and remove the stray colored rim pixels on the unlit limb

issues.where: planetary rings (crops B and G, image-03.png crops J and K, and image-06.png crop B)
issues.what: thin bright rings stair-step across shallow curves and break into noisy dots over the Milky Way, while close-up rings appear as faint straight streaks near the upper-left limb
issues.fix: filter and antialias thin ringlets in shader space to prevent pixel breakup and refine close-up ring scattering and falloff

issues.where: sunlit cyan cloud bands on the wide globe (crop A)
issues.what: isolated single-pixel white speckles pepper the mid-latitude cloud bands like un-antialiased noise
issues.fix: clamp or pre-filter sub-pixel cloud noise so highlights resolve smoothly across multiple pixels

issues.where: lower-left starfield and bottom dark limb (crops S, T, U and image-02.png crop D)
issues.what: faint rainbow lens-flare ghosts appear as muddy colored smudges in dark space, and the unlit bottom limb ends in a hard thin teal line
issues.fix: remove or clean up the low-amplitude chromatic flare blotches and soften the dark-side atmospheric rim cutoff

issues.what: the white vortex crest breaks into frothy spray-like wisps that read as sea foam, not convective cloud; the same storm sits in the lower right of image-13.png
issues.fix: rebuild the crest as layered cloud with a dark eye, and remove the splash tendrils

issues.where: panels E, H and I, cloud deck
issues.what: the cyan deck is a soft diagonal smear with no turbulent micro-detail, so the surface looks airbrushed at native size
issues.fix: break the uniform wind smear and add fine eddies that hold up in the crop

issues.where: panels A and C, cyan deck
issues.what: the same airbrushed diagonal smear, flatter and softer than the first stop, with no filament structure
issues.fix: add scale-varying turbulence so the bands are not one painted streak

issues.what: the moon's lit face is a smooth gradient about 50 pixels across, with no resolved relief
issues.fix: sharpen the terminator and put a few crater rims on the lit side
